authorization.request: run that experiment; user selected 179-call financial pilot (Recommended)
authorization.financial_replay: Approved offline fixed two-day paired pilot; failed/unattempted assessments fail closed. No production, exchange writes or deployment.

inputs.selection: Every new arm in fixed two-day window, chronological completed native bars, no confirmation/fill/outcome selection; order (as_of, minutes, setup).

financial.native_instrument_rules: Frozen research_instrument.json; current metadata, not historical venue rules.
financial.suppression_formula: SHA256(assessment-suppression-v1|seed|setup|minutes|candidate_id), lowest hashes up to that case AI permit count, among structurally accepted responses.
financial.matched_quantity: Allowed arming-candidate counts, not fills or active days. Conditional retrospective outcome-blind references, not deployable causal non-AI policies.
financial.timing: historical as_of + 1 second assumed candle availability + measured request/receipt wall latency, per independent case; no shared multi-case queue claim.
financial.on_missing_failed_or_late: Fail closed, no missing/unknown latency or usage converted to zero, no backdated catch-up entry. Preserve stopped-batch coverage.
financial.preserved: All deterministic confirmation, current quote/economics, cash, size/risk, ownership, daily-loss latches, IOC protection and retained dust/holdings.
financial.evaluation: Report costs/returns/closed R/activity/risk and all 16 suppression seeds. Existing conservative improves() rule against each primary comparator; sparse/inactive results are not robustness, profitability or deployment permission.
